I hardened the app in a few key ways:

- Added security headers and disabled `x-powered-by`
- Tightened JSON body size limits
- Added safer cookie/session handling and explicit cookie options
- Improved session storage/indexing and added a DB check for normalized emails
- Raised signup password minimum to 12 characters
- Added PostgreSQL SSL support via env config
- Kept the existing escaping/XSS protections intact

I also verified the updated server and route files parse cleanly.
